title: Make Your Mind a Temple of God | “How-to-Live” Talk With Meditation
formattedMarkdown:
# Make Your Mind a Temple of God
### Speaker • Sister Ranjana, Self-Realization Fellowship

### Opening Invocation
Divine Mother, Heavenly Father, Beloved God, Jesus Christ, Babaji Krishna, Lahiri Mahasaya, Swami Sri Yukteswar, Paramahansa Yogananda, saints of all religions, we bow to you all. May we realize that the kingdom of heaven is within us. Help us to purify our consciousness and make our minds a worthy temple for Your presence.

### The Sacred Interior
Paramahansa Yogananda often reminded us that we spend our lives decorating the outer mansion—our bodies, our homes, our reputation—while the inner temple, the sacred chamber of the soul, remains neglected, cluttered with the debris of worldly desires and restless thoughts. To make our mind a temple of God, we must begin the work of inner cleaning.

**Story • The King and the Empty Palace**

Story: A great king once decided to visit a small, remote village in his kingdom. The villagers were terrified, believing their humble homes were not fit for royalty. One man, however, spent weeks cleaning his small, dirt-floored hut. He removed every cobweb, scrubbed every corner, and placed a single, fresh lotus flower on a humble wooden pedestal. When the King arrived, he ignored the grand displays of the wealthy merchants and walked straight into the peasant’s hut. He said, 'I do not look for gold or silk; I look for the place that has been prepared for me.' In that moment, the peasant realized that the King was not interested in the luxury of the dwelling, but in the sincerity of the preparation.

### Purification Through Meditation
Meditation is the detergent of the soul. We cannot invite the Infinite into a mind filled with the static of anxieties and resentments. Through the Kriya Yoga techniques taught by our Guru, we learn to withdraw the life force from the senses and direct it inward toward the spine, toward the Christ Center at the point between the eyebrows.

1. **Stillness:** The first step is to quiet the restless waves of the mental lake.
2. **Devotion:** Fill the silence with the nectar of divine love.
3. **Surrender:** Let go of the 'I'—the ego—so the Divine can occupy the space.

### Living in the Presence
How do we maintain this temple throughout the day? By practicing the presence of God in every action. Whether you are working at your desk, caring for your family, or walking in nature, keep a thread of awareness connected to the Divine. Do not let the mind become a marketplace; keep it a sanctuary. When thoughts of irritation arise, treat them as uninvited guests and gently escort them out of your consciousness.

### Conclusion
Let us commit today to be the custodians of our own inner temple. When we offer our minds to God, He responds. He fills the emptiness with His light, His joy, and His infinite peace. May you find that presence within.
